methodology.simulation: Current repository production planner, motion, NPC traffic, jump, tank, and collision code through its imported harness and seeded pool. Starts at 42m/s, realistic mode. Stops at destruction.
methodology.geometry: Exact extrema/interval clipping of the continuous piecewise-linear relative AABB sweep between each step start and the uncorrected pre-collision endpoint. This is a read-only measurement probe; production collision checks and response are unchanged. Curved within-step paths are approximated by their linear chord.
methodology.envelopes: Matches production traffic contact envelope: |relative x| < 1.85m; |relative z| < NPC length/2 + 2.15m; body-height filter player y - NPC height < -0.15m. Signed gaps below zero denote overlap. All-height planar minima are also supplied.
methodology.encounters: Each category counts contiguous per-car threshold episodes, not frames. Side: side gap < 0.5m with longitudinal overlap. Bumper: front or rear gap < 2m with lateral overlap. Union deduplicates category overlap. Threshold episodes include penetrations; do not interpret them as collision-free passes. pairSeconds sums across cars.
methodology.overtakes: Only actual negative-to-nonnegative relative-z crossings on continuous visible live-car motion segments. Respawn/hidden segments and collision response jumps are excluded. No lane-nearness requirement.
methodology.following: Time with an ahead bumper gap from 0 up to the configured close-follow gap, lateral overlap, and body-height overlap. Union across cars; brief episodes are <= configured brief duration.
methodology.stripe: Continuous time more than 0.9m from every lane center, including airborne frames.
methodology.caveat: CPU production-harness measurement is not browser/WebGL, visual, frame-rate, or real-device validation. Swept overlap without a new impact can reflect discrete collision sampling or impact cooldown; it is not alone proof of a production collision bug.
